verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents mail import through its 'Import your mail' and 'Move from Gmail' help articles. Community users confirm an easy migration tool, the ability to fetch mail from Gmail, and smooth moves off Google, though one notes that filters and rules do not migrate. Contact import, which is half the story, has no evidence. Missing for 10: any evidence of contacts import, documentation detail beyond article titles on importing complete mail history (folders, sources supported), coverage of import from desktop clients/files.
